name: The Advocate
work_style: Purpose-driven and people-aware. Need to believe in the work to sustain energy. Work best with deep focus on meaningful problems. Natural synthesiser who connects ideas across domains. Protective of time and attention.
decision_making: Led by intuition and values alignment. Gather information holistically, then feel into the right choice. May override logic if something 'feels wrong' — often correctly.
leadership_style: Lead through inspiration and deep listening. Build consensus. Uncomfortable with authority for its own sake.
